findings.title: Five manifest mismatch tests fail during fixture injection before reaching the profile validator
findings.mechanism: preparedChangeManifest attempts UPDATE of manifest and manifest_hash. runtime_dispatch_manifest_frozen aborts every such UPDATE unconditionally with 'dispatch identity immutable'. t.Fatal occurs inside inject at line70, before snapshot(line140), AbandonPreparedQualification(line141) and precise Fault assertion(line144).
findings.impact: These five cases cannot establish intended profile/input/plan rejection coverage, and the complete v3 TestPreparedRunAbandonment suite is statically expected to fail.
findings.suggestion: Keep production triggers unchanged. For immutable manifest mismatch cases, load the genuinely eligible fixture's manifest into an independent in-memory copy under a read-only transaction, mutate it and call preparedRunAbandonmentProfileUpload directly; assert exact Fault and unchanged full DB snapshot. Retain the top-level successful path and genuinely reachable top-level negative cases. Alternatively construct a malformed initial manifest before its first insert in a strictly isolated fixture, without disabling immutability.
findings.actual: KNOWN_STATIC_BLOCKER; Root deliberately excluded whole new profile group, so no runtime failure was produced or mislabeled as a pass.

positive_review.evidence: Only the exact validated profile storage_key is returned as the upload exception. Checks bind plan root/runtime/task hash; marker plan/profile/contract/input/context; task/run/manifest inputs and context; exact one profile task input; admission bootstrap/profile/ref/hash/plan/root; current runtime binding and immutable Artifact ref; CURRENT/preRun/producer; seal timestamp before Run; stored bytes/hash/size/principal/sealed; decoded body and technical identity.

Only uploaded_content query adds storage_key<>validatedKey. Other11 footprint queries are unchanged: observations/runtime uploads/artifact uses/proofs/effects/billing/run Artifact/queue fences/command queue/control requests/qualification approvals. Another storage key with identical bytes remains forbidden; runtime-scoped use of the allowed key remains forbidden.

Fixture uploads and seals profile as Executor, creates qualification Task with that Artifact input, calls RegisterRuntimeQualificationPlan and BeginRuntimeQualification, and asserts LIVE, real immutable marker, PREPARED with empty worker identity and exact sealed upload. No BudgetLedgerEntry deletion. LIVE max_cost=nil reaches existing reserveQualificationDispatch lines244-257, which returns without RESERVE after unlimited-budget checks.

Eligible baseline is checked before corruption. Reachable negative cases assert Fault status/code plus distinctive message substring, then compare all logical table rows using a sorted content snapshot. The helper does not verify schema/triggers in the snapshot; original immutable triggers remain installed. This is broader than proof-count-only checks.

Production Service authority defaults nil and returns503. Current direct Owner and private verifier remain required. Test literal verifier is test-only; no native factory or public-route capability supplied. New historical adoption design is not implemented by this v3.
